nodes.summary: Under the secant comparison `wired(p') ≤ free(p)` for `p' < p`, the free and wired densities of a box edge agree for all `p ∈ (0, 1)` outside a countable set, namely the discontinuities of the monotone wired density.
nodes.title: Secant bound gives free–wired density agreement off a countable set

nodes.summary: The off-centre carrier vanishes for every `k`, by translation covariance of the wired box measures.
nodes.title: Off-centre carrier vanishes by translation covariance

nodes.summary: The off-centre carrier tends to zero, for every `p`.
nodes.title: Off-centre carrier tends to zero

nodes.summary: The free `q = 2` density of `e` is at most the wired marginal of `e + v` in `v + Λ_{N+k}`.
nodes.title: Free density is at most each translated wired marginal

nodes.summary: The wired marginals of the translated edge `e + v` in `v + Λ_{N+k}` converge to the wired `q = 2` density of `e`.
nodes.title: Translated wired marginals converge to the wired density

nodes.summary: If for every `k` the wired marginal of `e' + v` in `v + Λ_{N+k}` equals the wired marginal of `e` in `Λ_{N+k}`, then `e` and `e'` have the same wired density.
nodes.title: Equal wired densities from equal translated marginals
